_meta.title: Originated horizon lines v2 - 2026-11-15 through 2026-11-19
_meta.method: two independent estimators built on the official team tables, blended underneath; their disagreement is the headline confidence signal; the home-court advantage is pinned to the measured official home win rate

inputs.injury_edition_revision: 2026-11-16 01:15 PM ET (printed on the PDF as 'Injury Report: 11/16/26 01:15 PM')

home_court_anchor.primary_measurement: the official standings HOME/ROAD columns (the largest official sample); the final-score corpus measurement is published beside it as a cross-check
home_court_anchor.sigma_margin_source: population standard deviation of the margin on the official final-score corpus
home_court_anchor.formula: HCA_points = sigma_margin * Phi^-1(measured home win rate). The number of points is read off the measurement; nothing about it is fitted.
home_court_anchor.status: MEASURED - the home-court advantage is pinned to the official home win rate

league_pace_formula.status: ARITHMETIC identity used by the published NBA efficiency construction; the model also publishes the possession estimate taken straight from the official POSS column.

opponent_ppp_scaling.status: DERIVED from the official points-per-possession fields; the scaling exponent is a modelling choice fixed at 1.0.

estimator_blend_weights.status: MODELLING CHOICE - the two estimators are blended with equal weight. The headline confidence signal is their DISAGREEMENT, not the blend, so the blend weight does not drive the confidence gate.

bench_efficiency_ratio.status: MODELLING CHOICE - replacement players are assumed to produce at 0.85 points per minute of the absent player's rate. Sensitivity 0.75 / 0.85 / 0.95 is published. Flagged F4.

replacement_pool_size.status: MODELLING CHOICE - the replacement pool is the five rotation players behind the top eight by minutes.

absence_minutes_share_by_status.status: MODELLING CHOICE - the share of a listed player's captured season minutes that the redistribution removes is one minus the repo's published play probability by status (STATUS_PLAY_PROB). Available players lose nothing; Questionable players lose an expected half. The removed minutes are re-spread at the bench-efficiency ratio.

team_name_to_abbr.value: canonical mapping of the official full team names to the three-letter abbreviations used by every official surface

rest_penalty_points.status: MODELLING CHOICE - net-rating points per 100 possessions conceded to a team on a back-to-back or that has played three games in four. Flagged F4.

travel_penalty_points.value: 0.0012 points per mile of great-circle distance
travel_penalty_points.status: MODELLING CHOICE - calibrated so that a 3,000-mile cross-country trip is worth about 3.6 net-rating points per 100 possessions. Flagged F4.

luck_noise_band_z.status: MODELLING CHOICE - a strategy that leans on a team whose luck z-score is outside +/-1.5 is refused. Flagged F4.

market_leg_weight.status: BLOCKED BY SOURCE, not chosen: no official closing line is reachable from this sandbox, so the market leg of the blend carries zero weight and the blend is model-only. The machinery and the measured out-of-sample log loss that would set the weight are implemented and published.

gates.note: a pick must survive every gate to be published as a stakeable pick. No strategy has passed the strategy validation gates in this repository, so every pick below is published as MODEL OUTPUT - UNVALIDATED with zero stake, which is the honest state of the evidence.

estimator_a.estimator: A: possession x points-per-possession (official efficiency, traditional and opponent tables)

estimator_b.estimator: B: points-scored / points-allowed with an opponent and pace adjustment (official traditional and opponent tables only)

blend.confidence_signal: HEADLINE: |P(A) - P(B)| = 0.94 percentage points. A small disagreement means two independent official-input constructions agree, so the number is trustworthy; a large one means the line is not safe to publish.
